reference: CPU float32 explicit Qwen2 eager expression using the same rounded bfloat16 inputs; CPU bfloat16 SDPA and MPS eager also compared.
limitations: One seeded synthetic one-query attention case per six lengths; no model weights, real activations, full generation, layer accumulation, other masks/seeds/shapes or sampler failure. The 0.01 diagnostic threshold is not a language-quality guarantee. No observed tensor discrepancy at that threshold; neither a whole-model MPS correctness proof nor an MPS bug diagnosis.
